industry_analysis.culture: Gift-giving traditions deeply rooted in cultures worldwide. Religious and cultural significance of certain gifts. Handicraft traditions important cultural heritage. Corporate gifting customs vary by region.
industry_analysis.consumer: Personalization and uniqueness valued. Seasonal demand peaks (holidays, festivals). Experience gifts competing with physical products. Online gift discovery and direct shipping growing.
industry_analysis.infra: General product safety compliance required. Material composition and origin labeling. Gift packaging and presentation important. E-commerce fulfillment with gift wrapping options.
industry_analysis.population: Aging populations with disposable income for gifts. Younger consumers seeking experiential and ethical gifts. Cultural diversity creating demand for diverse gift options.
industry_analysis.social: Experiential and charitable giving trends. Sustainable and fair-trade gifts preferred. Social media gift guides and recommendations. Subscription box gifting model growing.
industry_analysis.environment: Sustainable and eco-friendly gift materials. Minimal and recyclable gift packaging. Carbon-neutral shipping options. Locally made and artisan products valued.
industry_analysis.opportunity: Personalized and custom-made gifts. Cultural and artisan handicrafts. Corporate gifting programs. Subscription and curated gift boxes.

compliance_summary: General product safety (GPSD), REACH compliance, CPSIA for children's products, material composition labeling, country of origin marking.
